title: WISP: Composable Representations for Wrist-Worn Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.28033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smartwatches and fitness bands are among the most common wearable devices, and large national health studies record movement at the wrist. Yet existing human activity recognition benchmarks mix sensors worn on different parts of the body, so they do not show how well activities can be recognised from the wrist alone. We introduce WristHARBench, a benchmark that standardises participant-disjoint evaluation across nine wrist-acceleration datasets and two additional multichannel inertial datasets. We hypothesise that different human activities leave complementary patterns in wrist motion, such as local shape, rhythm, temporal order and cross-axis relationships, and propose WISP (Wrist-Informed Space of Predictive Representations), a composable representation space that combines representations of these patterns with compatible classifiers. translated_title: WISP：面向腕戴式活动识别的可组合表征空间
translated_abstract: 智能手表和健身手环是最常见的可穿戴设备，许多大型国家级健康研究也在手腕部位记录运动数据。然而，现有的人体活动识别基准数据集混合了佩戴在身体不同部位的传感器数据，因此无法反映仅凭手腕数据识别活动的效果。我们提出了WristHARBench，这是一个标准化基准，在九个腕部加速度数据集和两个额外的多通道惯性数据集上实现了参与者不重叠的评估。我们假设不同的人类活动会在手腕运动中留下互补的模式，例如局部形状、节奏、时间顺序和跨轴关系，并据此提出WISP（腕部感知预测表征空间），这是一个可组合的表征空间，将这些模式的表征与兼容的分类器相结合。在九个主要数据集上，采用随机搜索的WISP实现了70.20%的平均Macro-F1，相比之下……
tldr: 该论文提出了标准化腕部活动识别基准WristHARBench和可组合表征空间WISP，通过融合手腕运动中的多种互补模式表征，仅凭腕部加速度数据即可将平均Macro-F1提升至70.20%。
